mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_records (user_id, change_value, reason, source_type, source_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeValue}, #{reason}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE credit_records SET user_id = #{userId}, change_value = #{changeValue}, reason = #{reason}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_id = #{sourceId}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
